datasets.label: FORCE Level-2 normalized BOA datacube tile X0067_Y0042 (European grasslands test site)
datasets.description: Cross-normalized FORCE Level-2 Bottom-of-Atmosphere (BOA) analysis-ready datacube for a single test-site tile (X0067_Y0042), derived from Landsat time series and consumed by the FORCE force-higher-level Time Series Analysis / Spectral Mixture Analysis step of the FONDA_trends workflow.
datasets.storage_location: FONDA Kubernetes cephfs, mounted read-only at /data/level2_norm (tile directory X0067_Y0042 plus datacube-definition.prj)
datasets.access_statement: Level-1 Landsat scenes were obtained from USGS and ESA-Copernicus repositories and processed to Level-2 BOA with FORCE, then cross-normalized between sensors. Only the single test-site tile X0067_Y0042 was consumed by this run, over the FORCE DATE_RANGE 2020-01-01 to 2023-12-31 (sensors LND04 LND05 LND07 LND08 LND09).

datasets.label: Spectral mixture analysis endmembers (DE_endmembers.txt)
datasets.description: Endmember spectra (gv, npv, soil, shade) supplied to FORCE Spectral Mixture Analysis via FILE_ENDMEM for the grassland trends test run.
datasets.access_statement: Endmember definition file distributed with the FONDA_trends workflow, used to unmix the BOA time series into ground-cover fractions.
